mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return in the lowest 25% of FEDFUNDS levels is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC between the UNRATE rise and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and unemployment (UNRATE) above their 3-month moving averages indicates stagflation, which triggers a loss of confidence in the economy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and UNRATE are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (CPIAUCSL * UNRATE) is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0%), an increase in the federal funds rate compresses corporate profit margins and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not negative in the tightening regime (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,000,000 units per month signals weak consumer demand and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000.0, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services output, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) below their 3-month moving averages indicates a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST are below their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (RSAFS * HOUST) is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 per month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth is above 100,000, or the Rank IC between PAYEMS and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
